name: Vlad Tepes
source:
"I am a denizen of the twilight..."

Based on Vlad the Impaler (also known as Vlad Tepes), who was a member of the House of Drăculești, a branch of the House of Basarab. He was posthumously dubbed Vlad the Impaler, and was a three-time Voivode of Wallachia, ruling mainly from 1456 to 1462, the period of the incipient Ottoman conquest of the Balkans.

A proud, great vampire hero who ruled over Europe's Transylvania. She suffers no damage from sunlight or crosses, but still doesn't like them. She's short, but still looks down on everyone, and speaks archaically. She doesn't like [url=/c5171]Joan of Arc[/url].

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char05a]English official site[/url]]
